62314.name: Guardian Drive · Anti-Crit
62314.SpecificEffects:
At the start of action, randomly selects <color=#F74848>3</color> allies within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>, equal to <color=#F74848>0.4</color>x Manipulator Repair AMT. Cannot repair destroyed parts.
When in combat, enemy Crit Rate is reduced by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.
